correctness.rationale: The W_(k−1,k) inclusion matrix has full row rank by induction, and disjointness boundary block expands in the same lower-inclusion rowspace, giving identical kernels Q. For any f in Q, lower subset sums vanish; Johnson unmarked adjacency has eigenvalue −k on Q and Kneser unmarked adjacency (−1)^k. Positive local losses kill precisely boundary-vanishing full eigenvectors; finite-dimensional dissipativity makes the orthogonal complement decay, so eventual survival is orthogonal P onto Q. S_v-invariance gives P_ST=a_r, boundary recurrence (r+1)a_r+(v-k-r)a_(r+1)=0 and rank-trace normalization a0=(n−2k)/(n−k), hence P_ST=a0(−1)^r/binom(n−k−1,r). For distance-two J_2(7,3), complement columns coincide and compressed 15x10 Gram is 4I+5J positive, so dark space is exactly rank10 antisymmetric; coherent state comparisons follow. Independently computed all matrices exactly with SymPy for n=7,k=3.
